name: Convolutional Neural Networks
learningObjectives: Understand the architecture of Convolutional Neural Networks
Learn how convolutional layers extract spatial features from images
Understand pooling operations and their role in CNNs
Visualize learned filters and feature maps
Apply CNNs to image classification tasks

controls.name: numFilters
controls.label: Number of Filters
controls.description: Number of convolutional filters to learn

controls.name: poolSize
controls.label: Pooling Size
controls.description: Size of the max pooling window

controls.name: learningRate
controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.description: Step size for gradient descent updates

controls.name: hiddenSize
controls.label: Hidden Layer Size
controls.description: Number of neurons in the dense hidden layer

datasets.name: Simple Shapes (8x8)
datasets.description: Small images of basic shapes for quick training

visualizations.name: Convolutional Filters
visualizations.description: Learned filter weights visualized as heatmaps

visualizations.name: Pooled Feature Maps
visualizations.description: Feature maps after max pooling operation

metrics.name: Precision
metrics.description: Proportion of positive predictions that are correct

metrics.name: Recall
metrics.description: Proportion of actual positives correctly identified

metrics.name: F1 Score
metrics.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall
